caption: The drawing consists of various blue figures and shapes on a rectangular, muted gray-green background with a wide, plain off-white border. The objects in the drawing include multiple abstract humanoid forms with simplified, stick-like bodies and limbs and geometric heads. Near the top center, there is a large figure with spiked hair or a sun-like radiance around its head, standing on a base with its arms raised. To the right of this figure, there is a smaller figure next to a rectangular enclosure or structure with a window or opening. Several other humanoid forms are scattered across the middle and lower areas, some with raised hands, some with outstretched legs, and some in dynamic, posed positions. One figure in the top right is positioned on another form, lifting its arms. There are also small, non-human shapes and linear objects, such as simple tree-like forms and umbrella or canopy-like shapes, distributed among the figures. The blue lines and filled shapes are the only color in the drawing, standing out against the solid background and border.
title: Petroglyph - Signs
